title: Open edX Authorization schema
description: A version 1.0 Open edX authorization schema contribution. Applications and deployment configuration use this format to define static permission categories, permissions, roles, and changes to existing roles.

schema_version.title: schema_version
schema_version.description: The authorization schema format version. Quote this value in YAML so it remains a string.

priority.title: priority
priority.description: The precedence used when contributions extend the same role. A higher number takes precedence when extensions conflict.

permission_categories.title: permission_categories
permission_categories.description: Permission categories contributed by this file. Categories group permissions for display and discovery but do not grant access.

examples.description: Permissions for viewing and editing course content.

permissions.title: permissions
permissions.description: Static permissions contributed by this file.

roles.title: roles
roles.description: Static roles contributed by this file.

examples.description: Reviews a course without changing it.

role_extensions.title: role_extensions
role_extensions.description: Changes to static roles defined in this file or another contribution.

identifier.description: A stable lowercase snake-case identifier that begins with a letter.

permission_id.description: A complete permission identifier formed from its namespace and name, separated by a period.

scope_namespace.description: A scope namespace registered by a ScopeData type.

display_name.description: The source-language name shown to users.

description.description: A source-language description shown to users.

icon.description: A case-sensitive icon name exported by @openedx/paragon/icons.

permission_list.description: A non-empty list of unique, complete permission identifiers.

scope_list.description: A non-empty list of unique scope namespaces.

permission_category.title: Permission category
permission_category.description: A category used to group permissions for display and discovery.

description.title: Category description
examples: Permissions for viewing and editing course content.

permission.title: Permission
permission.description: A static permission. Its complete identifier is namespace.name.

namespace.title: Permission namespace
namespace.description: The stable product domain that owns the permission.

name.title: Permission name
name.description: The operation within the product domain, normally beginning with a verb.

category.title: Permission category
category.description: The ID of a permission category in the combined schema.

scopes.title: Permission scopes
scopes.description: The scope namespaces where this permission can apply.

role.title: Role
role.description: A static role and the complete set of permissions assigned to it.

description.title: Role description
examples: Reviews a course without changing it.

scopes.title: Role scopes
scopes.description: The scope namespaces where this role can be assigned.

permissions.title: Role permissions
permissions.description: Every permission assigned to this role. Permissions are not inferred from other permissions.

hidden.title: Role hidden
hidden.description: Whether normal role discovery and selection interfaces omit this role.

role_extension.title: Role extension
role_extension.description: A partial change to an existing static role. Include at least one field in addition to role.

role.title: Extension role
role.description: The ID of the static role to change.

add_permissions.title: Extension add_permissions
add_permissions.description: Complete permission IDs to add to the role.

remove_permissions.title: Extension remove_permissions
remove_permissions.description: Complete permission IDs to remove from the role.

hidden.title: Extension hidden
hidden.description: Whether normal role discovery and selection interfaces omit this role.

permission_categories.description: Permissions for viewing and editing course content.

roles.description: Reviews a course without changing it.
